edges.carries: the full text of the notices file
the list of standing order instructions with their target fields and new values
the verified instructions and the current value of each target field
the instructions that failed verification and the reason for each
the old and new value of each field that was changed

nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractInstructions
nodes.role: pull out each rent standing order instruction the notices contain

nodes.name: VerifyInstructions
nodes.role: check that each instruction concerns the user's own rent standing order and names the fields to change

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the listed changes before any are made

nodes.name: ApplyChanges
nodes.role: update only the standing order fields the approved instructions name

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: report which fields changed and which instructions were skipped and why
